name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Bass goes with at least one of Boone, Grayreach, or Willowmere.
Boone goes with either Pike or Mossbank (but not both).
Mabel, Pike, and Willowmere belong to different catches.
Esther and Mabel are in different families.
Grayreach goes with neither Bluegill nor Pike.
The angler who landed the Bluegill and the angler who landed the Pike are in different watersheds.
The angler at Grayreach does not belong to the Sunfish Family.
